source.name: Master Data and Documents Replication Management

mapping.summary: Replicates master data and documents across subsidiary companies
claims: Designates a master company where master data is maintained and replicated to selected receiving companies
Replicates master data between companies in the same database or across databases/environments via web services
Unlimited number of tables can be set up for replication
When an original entry changes, sends the data held in linked master data tables
ETL-style field value transformation per receiving company
Optionally runs insert/delete/modify triggers in the destination company
Changes sent in real time or on a schedule
Exchanges documents between group companies, not only master data
